mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) increases gastrointestinal bleeding risk and may increase fluphenazine levels through CYP450 metabolism inhibition; fluphenazine increases CNS depression and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for gastrointestinal bleeding, increased extrapyramidal symptoms, and CNS depression; consider gastroprotection with PPI; use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
